Do you enjoy working with your hands and are you looking for a varied job in production? Then the position of Assembly Worker at Kingspan in Gemert is perfect for you.

As an assembly worker, you will work on a production line. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that EPS cool boxes are properly glued together. You will work at different stations. 
At one station, you will glue the sides of the cool box, and at the final station, you will assemble the remaining parts.
You are responsible for checking the final product and applying the correct label. After that, you place the order in the warehouse. Together with your team, you ensure that all products meet the required quality standards.

You won’t stay at the same station all the time—you will rotate with your colleagues, which keeps the work varied and interesting.

What we ask from you:

- You have a good command of the Dutch or English language
- Experience is not required; motivation is more important
- You live near Gemert, Helmond, Deurne, Uden, Venray, or Eindhoven

• Identifying and reporting deviations in the production process.

• A salary up to €3,400 gross per month, including shift allowance.

jobs.description:
As a Plastic Welder, you will be responsible for joining different components to create finished products using various welding techniques. You will work carefully according to work orders and technical instructions.

Your tasks include:

- Welding and assembling components using different welding techniques
- Working according to work orders, technical drawings and specified tolerances
- Ensuring the quality of the welding and finished products
- Performing quality checks and following the required control procedures
- Identifying and reporting deviations during the production process
- Suggesting improvements to product quality and production processes
- Following safety instructions and using personal protective equipment (PPE) when required

You will work in a day-shift schedule with the following working hours:

- Monday to Friday from 07:00 to 16:00 in Witbogt.

- Minimum B2 level of English or B2–C1 level of Dutch.
- MBO-level thinking and working ability.
- Experience with plastic welding is required.
- Knowledge of different plastic welding techniques, such as tacking, extrusion, and/or wire welding.
- Ability to read work orders, technical drawings, and work instructions.
- Technical insight and attention to tolerances and quality standards.
- Accurate, precise, and quality-focused way of working.
- Responsible and proactive attitude.
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
- Flexible and stress-resistant approach to work.
- Good communication and interpersonal skills.
- Willingness to follow production and safety procedures and use PPE when required.

Earn €14.99 per hour, work 40 hours a week and join a close-knit team in fish processing. As a production worker, you will help process and package fish products carefully in a safe working environment where quality comes first. 
About the function 
As a production worker in Volendam, you will start each day in a fresh, well-organised production hall. Together with your colleagues, you will make sure fish products are carefully processed, packaged and prepared for dispatch. You will operate machines, carry out quality checks and help out wherever needed. The work requires accuracy and a good pace, especially during busy periods. You will always follow strict hygiene rules. There is an informal atmosphere on the work floor, and you can always rely on your team. You will have room to develop yourself and take responsibility for your own tasks. 
What we offer - A salary of €14.99 per hour - A full-time job of 40 hours per week - Working in a close-knit and friendly team - Opportunities for personal development - A safe and clean working environment 
What we need - You speak Dutch or English - You are available to work full-time, 40 hours per week - You are a team player with a sense of responsibility
